authority: plans/PLAN_btc_h4_two_regime_v1.md section 1 (commit 113e0c2d). The census script loads and hashes this file BEFORE computing any state; the sha256 at count time is recorded in detector_census.json.

panel.loader: PSV1 scored namespace cells.load_btc_h4 imported VERBATIM read-only (sys.dont_write_bytecode=True); warmup truncated per PSV1 convention (WARMUP=153 H4 bars)
panel.runmax_scope: running maximum of the H4 close computed over the FULL staged panel from 2020-01-01 (NO pre-2020 ATH anchor; disclosed in plan section 1.1)

constants.provenance: DD_BEAR = PSV1 SPARSE_RISK_OFF frozen flat threshold (-30% drawdown); DD_RECOVER = PSV1 SPARSE_RISK_OFF frozen re-entry threshold (-10%); BULL_DWELL = 90 H4 bars = 15 days (round). All fixed before any state-conditional number exists; provenance plan section 1.2.

rules_in_order: 1) dd_t <= DD_BEAR                        -> BEAR (from ANY state, immediate)
2) state==BEAR and dd_t >= DD_RECOVER     -> UNCERTAIN (first recovery bar)
3) state==UNCERTAIN and streak(dd >= DD_RECOVER) >= BULL_DWELL_BARS -> BULL
state_machine.streak_law: consecutive bars with dd >= DD_RECOVER; reset by any dd < DD_RECOVER bar and by entering BEAR; only a transition FROM UNCERTAIN consumes it into BULL
state_machine.persistence: BULL has no exit to UNCERTAIN (exits only via rule 1); UNCERTAIN has no timeout

census_contract.merge_rule: merge adjacent same-state runs iff gap < 12 H4 bars (owner-recon convention)
census_contract.detection_lag_descriptive_only: bars from public calendar anchors (cycle top 2021-04-30 00:00 UTC = ERA-B1 end; bear bottom 2022-12-31 00:00 UTC = ERA-B2 end) to the first BEAR entry after the top anchor and the first BULL entry after the bottom anchor; DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, never a rule input
audits: BULL vs PSV1 UPTREND phase label (verbatim read-only import): agreement + contingency
BULL and BEAR vs SMA200(H4) lens: agreement + contingency (V2 forensic fact carried: SMA200 gate bound 0/86 entry bars)
no-lookahead mutation fixture: perturbing a future bar must not change any past state
hysteresis fixtures: rebound failing the dwell stays non-BULL; a -30% break enters BEAR immediately from BULL

sensitivity_ladder_report_only.output: per-bar agreement % of each ladder point vs the central machine; NEVER optimized

floors.source: PSV1 lane_btc_h4 pipeline/config.py verbatim (plan section 1.5); IMMUTABLE, never relaxed after any PnL
floors.application: a state gate failing ANY floor makes every arm gated on it NOT_RUN_THIN (slot FLAT, reported, never scored)

outcome_blindness: states/transitions/dwell/occupancy/floors/lag/agreement ONLY. No strategy returns, equity, PnL, costs or parameter search exist in this census.
